subject: short-tailed rooster

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Print an original rooster with a compact body and a short fan-like tail, viewed sideways while its head turns toward the viewer. Use indigo and ochre blocks with a small rust comb, keeping the face restrained and proud. Let the tail feathers become four broad carved shapes rather than fine plumage. Place the bird on cream paper with visible ink texture and no farm scenery or border. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
